title: Gravitee · API Program Overview
description: Executive and operations view of every API managed by Gravitee APIM: traffic, availability, latency attribution, policy outcomes, consumers and geography.

panels.title: API calls
panels.description: Total API calls handled by the gateway in the selected range (all v4 APIs, all plans).

panels.title: Availability (non-5xx)
panels.description: Share of calls that did NOT end in a 5xx. Client errors (4xx) are the consumer's fault and do not count against availability.

panels.title: Server errors (5xx)
panels.description: 5xx share. Includes gateway-generated 5xx (e.g. backend unreachable → 502/504) and 5xx returned by the backend.

panels.title: Client errors (4xx)
panels.description: 4xx share: invalid credentials, rate limiting, not found, bad requests.

panels.title: P95 response time
panels.description: 95th percentile of the total time seen by the consumer (gateway + backend).

panels.title: P95 gateway overhead
panels.description: 95th percentile of the time spent INSIDE Gravitee (policies, security, routing) — i.e. total response time minus backend time. This is the cost of the gateway itself.

panels.title: Active APIs
panels.description: Distinct APIs that received at least one call in the range.

panels.title: Active applications
panels.description: Distinct subscribed applications that called an API (keyless traffic excluded).

panels.title: Rate-limited calls (429)
panels.description: Calls rejected by rate-limit / quota / spike-arrest policies. A rising value usually means a consumer needs a bigger plan — an upsell signal, not an outage.

panels.title: Rejected credentials (401/403)
panels.description: Calls refused by plan security (missing / invalid / expired API key, JWT, OAuth2 token) or by access-control policies.

panels.title: Data served
panels.description: Response payload bytes sent to consumers.

panels.title: Gateway nodes up
panels.description: Gateway instances successfully scraped by Prometheus.

panels.title: Calls by status class
panels.description: Every API call, split by HTTP status class.

panels.title: Calls by API
panels.description: Click a series name to isolate it.

panels.title: Server error rate by API (5xx %)
panels.description: 5xx calls / all calls, per API.

panels.title: Gateway throughput (Prometheus, req/s)
panels.description: Real-time gateway request rate from the Prometheus endpoint (scraped every 5s). Excludes internal-API scrapes.

panels.title: Response time percentiles (consumer view)
panels.description: End-to-end time observed by the consumer.

panels.title: P95: total vs backend vs gateway overhead
panels.description: If 'Total' moves with 'Backend', the slowness is upstream. If it moves with 'Gateway overhead', look at policies (transformations, callouts, caching).

panels.title: Where the time goes (avg)
panels.description: Average share of response time spent in the backend vs in the gateway.

panels.title: Latency by API (ms)
panels.description: Click an API name to open its drill-down.

panels.title: Top APIs by P95 response time
Top applications by calls
panels.description: Subscribed applications. 'Anonymous (keyless)' groups keyless-plan traffic. With Enterprise stamping, see the Consumers dashboard for names.

panels.title: Top plans by calls
panels.description: Plan names come from the Assign Metrics stamp (custom.plan, Enterprise). Calls without a stamp are grouped by plan id.

panels.title: Gateway rejections by reason (error key)
panels.description: Every call the gateway refused or failed itself, by Gravitee error key: RATE_LIMIT_TOO_MANY_REQUESTS, QUOTA_TOO_MANY_REQUESTS, GATEWAY_PLAN_UNRESOLVABLE (no/invalid credentials), JWT_INVALID_TOKEN, API_KEY_INVALID, GATEWAY_CLIENT_CONNECTION_ERROR (backend unreachable), REQUEST_TIMEOUT… Tells you WHY, not just the status code.

panels.title: Rejections by policy
panels.description: Which policy or component stopped the call (security, rate-limit, quota, jwt, ip-filtering, json-validation…), straight from the request record.

panels.title: Rate-limited (429) by application
panels.description: Who is hitting their plan limits — candidates for a plan upgrade.

panels.title: Calls by country
panels.description: Calls by consumer country (Elasticsearch geo-IP on the client address; honours X-Forwarded-For).
